newsitem.title: USA: NuCo2 Inc acquires Atlanta distributor.
newsitem.headline: NuCo2 Inc acquires Atlanta distributor.

text.p: NuCo2 Inc said Tuesday that it has reached an agreement to buy the C02 assets and customer base of a carbon dioxide distributor located in the greater Atlanta area.
Neither the name of the seller nor terms of the transaction were disclosed.

The company said the acquisition will add approximately 325 accounts to its existing customer base, where it will provide service to customer rental accounts and refill service to customer-owned systems. The company expects to begin service on these accounts immediately.
NuCo2 Inc supplies bulk C02 systems and liquid carbon dioxide to retail establishments for use in the carbonation and dispensing of fountain beverages.
